"""Migrated Meridian CRM case_lifecycle workflow."""

from typing import Any


def _field(record: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> Any:
    """Return a field value, treating a missing field as the legacy empty string."""
    return record.get(name, "")


def _nvl(value: Any, default: str) -> Any:
    """Legacy NVL: substitute the default only for an empty or missing value."""
    return default if value == "" else value


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch an explicit case_lifecycle event without mutating the input."""
    updated = dict(record)
    audits: list[str] = []
    notifies: list[str] = []
    new_state = state
    matched = False

    # Transitions remain in legacy XML document order.
    if state == "N" and event == "assign" and _field(updated, "OWNER_UID") != "":
        new_state = "A"
        matched = True
        audits.append("CASE_ASSIGN")

    elif state == "N" and event == "auto_escalate":
        new_state = "A"
        matched = True
        updated["ESC_FLG"] = "Y"
        updated["SEV_CD"] = _nvl(_field(updated, "SEV_CD"), "3")
        audits.append("CASE_ESC")
        notifies.append("escalation")

    elif (
        state == "A"
        and event == "auto_escalate"
        and _field(updated, "ESC_FLG") != "Y"
    ):
        new_state = "A"
        matched = True
        updated["ESC_FLG"] = "Y"
        audits.append("CASE_ESC")
        notifies.append("escalation")

    elif state == "A" and event == "await_customer":
        new_state = "P"
        matched = True
        audits.append("CASE_PEND")

    elif state == "P" and event == "customer_reply":
        new_state = "A"
        matched = True

    elif (
        state == "A"
        and event == "resolve"
        and _field(updated, "RES_DT") != "00000000"
    ):
        new_state = "R"
        matched = True
        audits.append("CASE_RES")

    elif state == "R" and event == "close":
        new_state = "X"
        matched = True
        audits.append("CASE_CLOSE")

    elif state == "R" and event == "reopen":
        new_state = "A"
        matched = True
        updated["RES_DT"] = "00000000"
        audits.append("CASE_REOPEN")

    if not matched:
        audits.append("WF_NOMATCH")

    return {
        "state": new_state,
        "record": updated,
        "audits": audits,
        "notifies": notifies,
        "matched": matched,
    }
